propositions: fsck and compact-all scans traverse all archived tickets on every run despite archive status making them irrelevant to default operations, causing O(all tickets) performance degradation as stores grow.

rebar archive must perform a terminal fold inline (reusing compact_cli with threshold=0 and horizon=0) before writing the ARCHIVED event to ensure archived tickets have complete SNAPSHOTs covering all events and are already folded.

fsck and compact-all must default to scanning only active tickets via a shared iterator that checks the .archived marker and confirms net-archived state, skipping archived directories unless --include-archived flag is passed.
The --include-archived flag must thread through fsck, compact-all, and the repair path to restore full store walks and fold legacy-archived unfolded tickets when needed.
The implementation reuses ticket list's proven archive-marker semantics and net-archival confirmation logic rather than inventing a second notion of active status.
